quarterly_data.quarter: Belimo press release: Belimo Strengthens Its Hinwil, Zurich Site with New (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Belimo officially opened a new production and logistics building at its Hinwil headquarters, adding production and logistics capacity: the existing production area of 12,600 square meters was expanded by an additional 6,200 square meters, with an automated high-bay warehouse of 3,000 pallet spaces and an automated small-parts warehouse of 80,000 container spaces; Belimo says it is also continuously expanding capacity in other key markets including the USA, Germany and China. CEO Lars van der Haegen: the investment creates the conditions for further global growth and increased delivery capability.
